rate_policy_note: Capture the rate a non-logged-in guest sees when they search the hotel — including any publicly displayed promotion (Getaway Deal, Limited Time Offer, Mobile rate, Genius-style public discount). This is the rate that actually converts bookings, so it's our true competitive benchmark. Do NOT strip promotions to recover a 'rack rate' — we want what a guest pays, not what a hotel quotes internally.
